component.name: pyCertWiz
component.summary: Certificate manager for the UK e-Science CA and ACME CAs

description.p: pyCertWiz requests, renews, exports and deploys user and host certificates from the UK e-Science CA (replacing the Java CertWizard client) and from ACME CAs such as Let's Encrypt. It can use CertWizard's Java keystore as a live store, and never writes a private key without passphrase protection.
